prerequisites: Two DGX Stations with one NVIDIA GB300 each and ConnectX-8 RDMA connectivity.
The target checkpoint is pre-downloaded under MODEL_ROOT on both nodes.
Docker, curl, registry, PyPI, and GitHub access are available during setup.
Set ROLE, HEAD_IP, WORKER_IP, NCCL_SOCKET_IFACE, GPU_UUID, and MODEL_ROOT on each node.
limitations: Configured for pipeline parallel 2 and tensor parallel 1 across exactly two nodes.
Requires Ray 2.56.0 and the pinned vLLM warmup backport downloaded during setup on both nodes.
No measured performance manifest is published for this exact configuration.

runtime.label: ARM64 container with pinned warmup backport
runtime.setup_instructions: Run in Bash on both nodes after exporting the required role-specific variables. MODEL_ROOT must be the local Hugging Face cache root containing the checkpoint. Setup downloads and checksum-verifies the pinned warmup patch from GitHub.
runtime.setup_command:
set -euo pipefail

: "${ROLE:?set ROLE to head or worker}"
: "${HEAD_IP:?set HEAD_IP to the head-node ConnectX-8 address}"
: "${WORKER_IP:?set WORKER_IP to the worker-node ConnectX-8 address}"
: "${NCCL_SOCKET_IFACE:?set NCCL_SOCKET_IFACE to the bootstrap interface}"
: "${GPU_UUID:?set GPU_UUID to the local GB300 UUID}"
: "${MODEL_ROOT:?set MODEL_ROOT to the local Hugging Face cache root}"

CTR=nemo-ray
IMG=vllm/vllm-openai:v0.25.1-aarch64
MODEL=nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Ultra-550B-A55B-NVFP4
RAY_VERSION=2.56.0
AIPERF_VERSION=0.11.0
VLLM_WARMUP_PATCH_SHA256=e9f181d3b6957fccad0f92c270caa0e6a32277de6a0b62ec43788aafe4f6c701

PATCH=$(mktemp /tmp/vllm-pr48363.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -f "$PATCH"' EXIT
curl -fL --retry 3 --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 120 \
  https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/c65ba6aa8ffe9fa6719c5dcdda747b59d7d32520.patch \
  -o "$PATCH"
printf '%s  %s\n' "$VLLM_WARMUP_PATCH_SHA256" "$PATCH" | sha256sum -c -

case "$ROLE" in
  head) VLLM_HOST_IP=$HEAD_IP ;;
  worker) VLLM_HOST_IP=$WORKER_IP ;;
  *) echo 'ROLE must be head or worker' >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac

test -d "$MODEL_ROOT/hub/models--nvidia--NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Ultra-550B-A55B-NVFP4"
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,uuid --format=csv,noheader | grep -F 'NVIDIA GB300'
for HCA in mlx5_0 mlx5_1; do
  NDEV=$(cat "/sys/class/infiniband/$HCA/ports/1/gid_attrs/ndevs/3")
  echo "$HCA -> $NDEV"
done

docker run -d --name "$CTR" --network host --shm-size 16g \
  --gpus device="$GPU_UUID" \
  --device=/dev/infiniband/uverbs0 --device=/dev/infiniband/uverbs1 --ulimit memlock=-1 \
  -e VLLM_HOST_IP="$VLLM_HOST_IP" \
  -e VLLM_USE_RAY_V2_EXECUTOR_BACKEND=1 \
  -e NCCL_IB_HCA=mlx5_0,mlx5_1 -e NCCL_IB_GID_INDEX=3 -e NCCL_IB_TC=106 \
  -e NCCL_NET_GDR_LEVEL=PHB -e NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME="$NCCL_SOCKET_IFACE" \
  -e NCCL_IB_QPS_PER_CONNECTION=4 -e NCCL_IB_PCI_RELAXED_ORDERING=1 \
  -e HF_HOME=/models/huggingface \
  -e HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 -e TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 \
  -v "$MODEL_ROOT:/models/huggingface" \
  --entrypoint sleep "$IMG" infinity

docker exec "$CTR" pip install --break-system-packages "ray==$RAY_VERSION"
docker exec "$CTR" python3 -c \
  "import ray; assert ray.__version__ == '$RAY_VERSION'; print('ray', ray.__version__)"

if test "$ROLE" = head; then
  docker exec "$CTR" pip install --break-system-packages --ignore-installed \
    'blinker==1.9.0' "aiperf==$AIPERF_VERSION"
  docker exec "$CTR" python3 -c \
    "import importlib.metadata as m; assert m.version('aiperf') == '$AIPERF_VERSION'; print('aiperf='+m.version('aiperf'))"
fi

docker cp "$PATCH" "$CTR":/tmp/vllm-pr48363.patch
docker exec "$CTR" bash -c '
  set -euo pipefail
  SITE=/usr/local/lib/python3.12/dist-packages
  patch --batch --forward --fuzz=0 --dry-run -d "$SITE" -p1 \
    < /tmp/vllm-pr48363.patch
  patch --batch --forward --fuzz=0 -d "$SITE" -p1 \
    < /tmp/vllm-pr48363.patch
'
docker exec "$CTR" python3 -c \
  "from vllm.model_executor.warmup.hybrid_mamba_warmup import hybrid_mamba_triton_warmup; print('PR48363_READY')"

serve.label: Start PP2 head
serve.instructions: Start this head command and then run the worker command on the second node. The head waits for both Ray GPUs before launching vLLM.
serve.command:
set -euo pipefail

: "${HEAD_IP:?set HEAD_IP to the head-node ConnectX-8 address}"
CTR=nemo-ray
MODEL=nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Ultra-550B-A55B-NVFP4

docker exec -d "$CTR" ray start --head \
  --node-ip-address="$HEAD_IP" --port=6379 --num-gpus=1 --block

for _ in $(seq 1 120); do
  docker exec "$CTR" ray status 2>/dev/null | grep -F '2.0 GPU' && break
  sleep 2
done
docker exec "$CTR" ray status | grep -F '2.0 GPU'

docker exec -d "$CTR" bash -c "
  exec env VLLM_EXECUTE_MODEL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=3600 \
    vllm serve '$MODEL' \
    --served-model-name nemotron-ultra --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --trust-remote-code \
    --tensor-parallel-size 1 --pipeline-parallel-size 2 --distributed-executor-backend ray \
    --kv-cache-dtype fp8 --max-model-len 40960 --enable-prefix-caching \
    --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9 --max-num-seqs 256 \
    --distributed-timeout-seconds 600 \
    > /tmp/vllm_serve.log 2>&1
"

HEALTHY=0
for _ in $(seq 1 120); do
  if docker exec "$CTR" curl -fsS --max-time 3 http://127.0.0.1:8000/health \
      >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo 'vLLM READY'
    HEALTHY=1
    break
  fi
  if ! docker exec "$CTR" pgrep -f '[v]llm serve' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    docker exec "$CTR" tail -n 100 /tmp/vllm_serve.log
    echo 'vLLM exited during startup' >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  sleep 10
done
if test "$HEALTHY" != 1; then
  docker exec "$CTR" tail -n 100 /tmp/vllm_serve.log
  echo 'vLLM health check timed out' >&2
  exit 1
fi

additional_commands.label: Join PP2 worker
additional_commands.instructions: Run after the head Ray process has started.
additional_commands.command:
set -euo pipefail

: "${HEAD_IP:?set HEAD_IP to the head-node ConnectX-8 address}"
: "${WORKER_IP:?set WORKER_IP to the worker-node ConnectX-8 address}"
CTR=nemo-ray

docker exec -d "$CTR" ray start --address="$HEAD_IP:6379" \
  --node-ip-address="$WORKER_IP" --num-gpus=1 \
  --object-store-memory=8589934592 --block

runtime.label: Container (community, mutable, ARM64, custom B12x)
runtime.setup_instructions: Run on every node after setting `HF_TOKEN`; replace the node-specific placeholders.
runtime.setup_command:
# Example two-Spark values (adjust to your network):
#   HEAD_IP="10.100.32.1"        # head node IP on the ETH subnet
#   ETH_IF="enp1s0f0np0"        # ConnectX baseboard ethernet (socket/control)
#   IB_IF="rocep1s0f0,roceP2p1s0f0"   # RoCE HCA names (data plane) - use both "twins"!
export HEAD_IP="<head-connectx-ip>"
export ETH_IF="<connectx-interface>"
export IB_IF="<roce-interface-1>,<roce-interface-2>"
export MASTER_PORT=29501
export IMAGE="eugr/spark-vllm-b12x:latest"
export HF_CACHE_DIR="$HOME/.cache/huggingface"

mkdir -p "$HF_CACHE_DIR" "$HOME/.cache/vllm" "$HOME/.cache/flashinfer" "$HOME/.triton" "$HOME/.cache/b12x"

docker run --rm -it \
  --privileged \
  --gpus all \
  --ipc host \
  --network host \
  --shm-size=16g \
  --ulimit nofile=1048576:1048576 \
  --ulimit memlock=-1 \
  --ulimit stack=67108864 \
  -e HF_TOKEN=$HF_TOKEN \
  -e MN_IF_NAME="$ETH_IF" \
  -e UCX_NET_DEVICES="$ETH_IF" \
  -e NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME="$ETH_IF" \
  -e NCCL_IB_HCA="$IB_IF" \
  -e NCCL_IB_DISABLE=0 \
  -e OMPI_MCA_btl_tcp_if_include="$ETH_IF" \
  -e GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME="$ETH_IF" \
  -e TP_SOCKET_IFNAME="$ETH_IF" \
  -e NCCL_IGNORE_CPU_AFFINITY=1 \
  -e HEAD_IP="$HEAD_IP" \
  -e MASTER_PORT="$MASTER_PORT" \
  -v "$HF_CACHE_DIR:/root/.cache/huggingface" \
  -v "$HOME/.cache/vllm:/root/.cache/vllm" \
  -v "$HOME/.cache/flashinfer:/root/.cache/flashinfer" \
  -v "$HOME/.triton:/root/.triton" \
  -v $HOME/.cache/b12x:/root/.cache/b12x \
  --entrypoint /bin/bash \
  "$IMAGE"

serve.label: Launch head
serve.command:
export CUTE_DSL_ARCH="sm_121a"
export SAFETENSORS_FAST_GPU="1"
export VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD="spawn"
export VLLM_SSM_CONV_STATE_LAYOUT="DS"
export VLLM_USE_AOT_COMPILE="1"
export VLLM_USE_MEGA_AOT_ARTIFACT="1"
export VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER="1"
export B12X_POLICY_MODE="auto"
export VLLM_ENABLE_ROCE_ALLREDUCE="1"
export VLLM_ROCE_ALLREDUCE_MAX_SIZE="2MB"

vllm serve local-inference-lab/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4 \
  --host 0.0.0.0 \
  --port 8000 \
  --trust-remote-code \
  --tensor-parallel-size 2 \
  --pipeline-parallel-size 1 \
  --mamba-cache-mode align \
  --enable-prefix-caching \
  --enable-chunked-prefill \
  --dtype bfloat16 \
  --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \
  --quantization modelopt_mixed \
  --block-size 16 \
  --load-format b12x \
  --max-model-len 262144 \
  --max-num-seqs 16 \
  --max-num-batched-tokens 4096 \
  --speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":4}' \
  --gdn-decode-kernel b12x \
  --linear-backend b12x \
  --moe-backend b12x \
  --no-enable-flashinfer-autotune \
  --mm-encoder-tp-mode data \
  --reasoning-parser qwen3 \
  --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml \
  --enable-auto-tool-choice \
  --compilation-config '{"pass_config":{"fuse_act_quant":true}}' \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.7 \
  --nnodes 2 \
  --node-rank 0 \
  --master-addr "$HEAD_IP" \
  --master-port "$MASTER_PORT"
